references.description: Sorted by file, line, column, constant_name and defining_pack_name. A constant that several packs define gives a reference to each of them at the same place.

line.description: Counted from 1. null in ERB, where pks keeps no source positions, so an ERB file's references to one constant are listed once. `pks check -o json` gives 0 there.

column.description: Counted in bytes from 0. null when line is null.

constant_name.description: Fully qualified, as `::Foo::Bar`. A reference that pks infers from an association, as `has_many :tacos` gives `::Taco`, is at the association, so the constant's name isn't written at line and column.

violations.description: The violations `pks check --ignore-recorded-violations` finds in this reference, in the order dependency, privacy, visibility, layer, folder_privacy. Empty when the reference breaks no rule that is enforced, as when a dependency is declared or enforce_dependencies is false.

strict.description: Whether the pack that enforces the rule is strict about it: the referencing pack for dependency and layer, and the defining pack for privacy, visibility and folder_privacy

recorded.description: Whether a package_todo.yml records this violation. `pks check` reports only the violations that are not recorded.
